sourceDescription: AnixQ — аниме с AnimeLib: каталог, плеер без рекламы, синхронизация с Shikimori.

appRepositories.appDescription:
Search by frame: recognise characters with AnimeTrace

trace.moe matches whole frames and fails on short-video screenshots (cropped
to vertical, mirrored, overlaid). AnimeTrace recognises characters instead:
on the user's GTok screenshot it identified Alisa Mikhailovna Kujou from
'Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian', where trace.moe returned an
unrelated title. Runs in parallel with trace.moe; the work title (usually
Japanese) is matched via Shikimori search to AnimeLib and shown first as
'Узнали по персонажу' with the recognised characters.
